stem: Which statement best explains how bank failures contributed to the Great Depression?

options.label: A
options.text: People lost their savings because the government did not insure bank deposits.

options.label: B
options.text: Business could not be done when President Franklin Roosevelt declared a bank holiday.

options.label: C
options.text: The interest rates on bank loans were too high.

options.label: D
options.text: Foreign investors did not invest enough in U.S. banks.
